import re, datetime as dt
from collections import defaultdict

SRC = r"C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp\prompt-evals-session-e1tu81bt\personal_expenses.txt"
MONTHS = {"jan":1,"feb":2,"mar":3,"apr":4,"may":5,"jun":6,"jul":7,"aug":8,"sep":9,"oct":10,"nov":11,"dec":12}

DATE_PATTERNS = [
    (r"\b(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b", lambda m: (int(m[1]), int(m[2]), int(m[3]))),
    (r"\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})/(\d{2})\b", lambda m: (2000+int(m[3]), int(m[1]), int(m[2]))),
    (r"\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})\b", lambda m: (2026, int(m[1]), int(m[2]))),
    (r"\b(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b", lambda m: (2026, int(m[1]), int(m[2]))),
    (r"\b(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\.?\s+(\d{1,2})\b",
     lambda m: (2026, MONTHS[m[1].lower()], int(m[2]))),
]
AMOUNT_RE = re.compile(r"(-?)\s*\$?\s*(-?)\s*\$?(\d+\.\d{2})\s*(?:\([^)]*\))?\s*$")

def parse(line):
    s = line.strip().lstrip("-").strip()
    date = None
    for pat, fn in DATE_PATTERNS:
        m = re.search(pat, s)
        if m:
            date = dt.date(*fn(m)); s = s[:m.start()] + " " + s[m.end():]; break
    s = re.sub(r"\(\s*\)", "", s).strip()
    m = AMOUNT_RE.search(s)
    if not date or not m:
        return None
    amt = float(m[3]) * (-1 if (m[1] or m[2]) else 1)
    desc = re.sub(r"^[\s:|,\-]+|[\s:|,\-]+$", "", s[:m.start()])
    desc = re.sub(r"\s*[|,]\s*$|\s+-+\s*$", "", desc).strip(" :|,-")
    return date, desc, amt

CATS = {
    "Eating out / coffee": ["Local Coffee Co","Chipotle","McDonald's","Rustic Tap Brewery","Panera Bread",
                            "Starbucks","Sushi Kame","Thai Orchid","Bagel Corner","Luigi's Pizza"],
    "Shopping": ["Amazon","Best Buy","Target","Old Navy","REI","IKEA","Barnes & Noble","Home Depot",
                 "Return processed - REI"],
    "Groceries": ["Trader Joe's","Aldi","Kroger","Costco","Whole Foods"],
    "Gas": ["Shell","Chevron","BP Gas"],
    "Transport / parking / car": ["Lyft","Uber","City Parking Authority","Jiffy Lube"],
    "Subscriptions & bills": ["iCloud+ 200GB","Amazon Prime","Xfinity Internet","Netflix","Spotify Premium",
                              "Planet Fitness App","Verizon Wireless"],
    "Health & fitness": ["Planet Fitness","Riverside Physical Therapy","Walgreens","CVS Pharmacy",
                         "Dr. Hensley Dental Copay"],
    "Entertainment": ["Steam","Spotify Concert","AMC Theatres","Bowl-O-Rama","Ticketmaster"],
    "Travel (Aug trip)": ["Delta Air Lines","Airport Parking","Marriott","Hertz Rental Car"],
    "UNCATEGORIZED": ["Zelle Payment","ATM Cash Withdrawal","Venmo - Sam","PayPal Transfer"],
}
MERCH2CAT = {m: c for c, ms in CATS.items() for m in ms}

rows, bad = [], []
for n, line in enumerate(open(SRC, encoding="utf-8"), 1):
    if n <= 3 or not line.strip():
        continue
    p = parse(line)
    if p is None or p[1] not in MERCH2CAT:
        bad.append((n, line.rstrip(), p)); continue
    rows.append(dict(line=n, date=p[0], desc=p[1], amt=p[2], cat=MERCH2CAT[p[1]]))

print(f"parsed {len(rows)} rows; unparsed/unknown: {len(bad)}")
for b in bad: print("  BAD", b)

# sanity: every parsed date is in Jun-Aug 2026
assert all(dt.date(2026,6,1) <= r["date"] <= dt.date(2026,8,31) for r in rows)

# duplicates: same date + merchant + amount
seen, dups = {}, []
for r in rows:
    k = (r["date"], r["desc"], r["amt"])
    if k in seen: dups.append((seen[k], r))
    else: seen[k] = r
print("\nexact duplicates (removed):")
for a, b in dups: print(f"  lines {a['line']} & {b['line']}: {b['date']} {b['desc']} {b['amt']:.2f}")
dup_lines = {b["line"] for _, b in dups}

# near-duplicates: same merchant within 2 days, amounts within 10% -> report only
print("\nnear-duplicates (reported, kept):")
for i, a in enumerate(rows):
